description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Attach Lightning], [Awoken Lightning], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Gentle Thunder Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Lightning
description.text: Lightning abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Lightning abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Attach Lightning
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Lightning damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Lightning resistance +20%

description.name: Gentle Thunder Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Gentle Thunder after using a Lightning ability

description.name: Gentle Thunder
description.text: 4/4/4/6 single attacks (1.32 each) if 0-1/2/3/4 female allies are alive, grants [Quick Cast 1] to all allies in the character's row if 2 or more female allies are alive, grants [Buff Lightning 10% (15s)] to all allies if 3 or more female allies are alive

description.name: Buff Lightning 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Lightning damage dealt by 10%, cumulable
